organicResults.title: How to Season a Wok
organicResults.snippet: Wash the wok, heat it until the water evaporates, then coat it with a thin layer of oil.

organicResults.title: How to Season a Wok - The Woks of Life
organicResults.snippet: Seasoning a carbon steel wok gives it a natural nonstick surface.

organicResults.title: 3 Ways to Season a Wok - wikiHow
organicResults.snippet: Heat the wok over high heat, add oil and swirl it to coat the inside evenly.

aioverview.text: Seasoning a carbon steel or cast iron wok means heating a thin layer of oil until it polymerizes.
aioverview.markdown: Seasoning a carbon steel or cast iron wok means **heating a thin layer of oil until it polymerizes**.[Wok & Skillet](https://www.wokandskillet.com/how-to-season-a-wok/)
